summary: Luckin Coffee filed a 6-K announcing Q1 2026 results and a new share repurchase program of up to US$300 million over one year. The board approved the buyback, signaling confidence in strategy and long-term prospects. The program is an open-market issuer tender , returning capital to shareholders. Net revenues rose 35.3% YoY to RMB12.0 billion, with 33,596 stores at quarter-end. Watch execution pace and impact on OTC-traded stock liquidity; no premium or fixed-price tender terms disclosed.
